title: Is There No Longer Wisdom in Teman

request.style: English, male baritone solo with sparse choir, acoustic guitar, cello, harp, ambient pads, somber and reflective, 72 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
Eliphaz son of Esau had a firstborn son
His name was Teman among the many listed there
Omar Zepho Gatam and Kenaz followed him
Chiefs descended from the mother Adah in the land

[Chorus]
Is there no longer wisdom in Teman
Counsel has perished from the prudent
Their wisdom has decayed in the dust

[Verse]
He founded a clan in the land of Edom
A chief among the people known by name
Husham ruled from the land of the Temanites
Before the kings of Israel reigned upon the throne

[Chorus]
Is there no longer wisdom in Teman
Counsel has perished from the prudent
Their wisdom has decayed in the dust

[Bridge]
Bozrah will become a horror and a disgrace
A ruin and a curse forevermore
The pride of the heart has deceived the eagle
Who builds his nest as high as the sky

[Outro]
Leave your orphans I will keep them alive
Let your widows trust in me
Is there no longer wisdom in Teman
